description: Angular component for a power button widget in the Thingsboard platform, handling SVG rendering, user interaction, and state management.

classes.name: PowerButtonWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a customizable power button widget with SVG graphics and state handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, value getters, and subscriptions.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Handles post-view initialization, triggers SVG drawing if pending.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources like resize observers.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Additional initialization, sets border radius and triggers SVG drawing.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Updates internal value and SVG shape when the power state changes.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Updates disabled state and SVG shape.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user click, toggles power state, updates via setters, and manages SVG pressed state.

methods.name: drawSvg
methods.description: Creates and configures the SVG shape for the power button.

methods.name: updateDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state on the SVG shape.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts SVG scale based on container size.
